data.fund_type: An Open Ended Equity Linked Saving Scheme with a Statutory Lock in of 3 years and Tax Beneﬁt.
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to achieve long-term capital appreciation by investing primarily in shares ofcompanies that will typically be included in the BSE 200 Index and are in a position to beneﬁt from the anticipated growthand development of the Indian economy and its markets. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Schemewill be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equity and Equity-related Instruments -80 to 100%, Debt and money market instruments-0 to 20%.
data.fund_managers: Mr. George Thomas, Mr. Christy Mathai, Mr. Ketan Gujarathi
